name: openloop-monorepo
description: Desktop Automation Platform with Visual Orchestration, Plugins, Agent & CLI integration

scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n "core,web,electron" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "pnpm --filter @openloop/core start" "pnpm --filter @openloop/desktop dev" "wait-on tcp:5173 && pnpm --filter @openloop/desktop start"
